text:
maya: Quick sync  we're leaning toward preferring protobuf for the new typed endpoints. Need a safe fallback for older mobile SDKs.

 tom: Gateway should negotiate via Accept header. If Accept: application/x-protobuf -> route proto handler, else route to json adaptor.

 ari: Also add a canary header (X-RW-Proto-Canary) so we can bias by client id/version.

 maya: Two ops concerns: quota attribution needs to be consistent and product wants clear telemetry for fallback rates.

 carlos: Quota idea: normalize billing at runtime to decoded token units. Router attaches x-client-surface and transport metadata so billing uses the same unit regardless of wire format.

 ari: Telemetry: emit router.fallback.count{reason=negotiation} and router.transport.latency{transport=proto|json}. Console can graph both.

 sophia: For rollout UX we can reuse existing per-route weight overrides. Console slider (0-100%) + client-version breakdown + one-click rollback.

 deploy-bot: Caution: auto-rollbacks should use absolute rate AND relative increase vs baseline to avoid noisy infra triggers.

 tom: Architecture choice: integrate proto handling into gateway vs sidecar adapter that negotiates and forwards normalized JSON. Sidecar = lower backend risk, gateway change = perf win.

 ari: Sidecar wins for canary. We can evaluate moving into gateway after stable metrics for ~2 weeks.

 carlos: Ensure adapter preserves trace headers and x-request-id for tracing.

 maya: Action items: sophia: prototype sidecar and envoy route using Accept header (EOD Fri). ari: add metrics for fallback and transport latency (Wed). tom: prepare rollout toggle and rollback runbook. carlos: document quota normalization and mapping table (Thu).

 sophia: ack. Spike PR will include curl examples: 
 # proto client
 curl -H "Accept: application/x-protobuf" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.pb https://gateway.prod/api/v1/thing:mutate

 # json client
 curl -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"foo":"bar"}' https://gateway.prod/api/v1/thing/mutate

 ari: I'll mock a Console panel with transport breakdown + fallback % and client-version heatmap.

 tom: Router logs must include negotiated_transport and fallback_reason fields (structured json) for searching and alerts.

 maya: sounds good. anyone object?

 carlos: No objections.

 sophia: I'll post the spike PR here when ready. :rocket:

 maya: thanks all.
